गङ्गाधर called also लक्ष्मीधर younger brother of Viṣṇu,

saronagara:

[]

Govatsa (1450), father of Raghunātha (Maitrāvaruṇa-
prayoga). W. p. 30. 31.
[]

(Vivādacandra etc.) and of Bālambhaṭṭa (Mitākṣarā-
ṭīkā). By report, the authorship of their works
belongs to herself.

Printed in Ṣaṭkośānāṃ Saṃgrahaḥ. Benares 1874.

लक्ष्मीनिश्चलत्वोपाय a fictitious title. The work treats
of the worship of Lakṣmī. CS 2, 112.
